notes.title: 1.0004 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Minor Quality of Life features
 Slightly boosted XP received
 Fixed rare bug where player would get stuck after completing Upstanding Citizen quest
 Fixed bug with Serious Sprinkler recipe
 Fixed bug with players being unable to scroll through hotbar by using mousewheel

notes.title: 1.0002 Hotfix Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Patch notes:


 Burger shack now restocks weekly instead of monthly
 Adjusted the color of watered soil to make it clearer which tiles have been watered

notes.title: 1.0001 Hotfix Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thanks so much for playing Peachleaf!! :) 

First hotfix live to address a couple of serious bugs and a few typos. Please do continue to let me know in the forums if you encounter any bugs or have any feedback!


 Fixed a fatal error in shops
 Fixed Invert Mouse Wheel setting not saving
 Fixed typos here and there
